blurb: Four seats: a driver and three passengers who shoot their own weapons

notes.model: The owner's Tactical Off-Road Beast and its Rugged Off-Road Tire (Meshy, owned; content/guns.json): a long tube-frame buggy with a roof gun, its hubs bare, so the tires go on at its hubs and it rides on them.
notes.half: The body is 1.74 m wide and 1.44 m tall on 0.24 m of ride height, 4.4 m long; the tires stand out to 2.2 m.
notes.seats: On the model's seats (measured on the model): two rows of cushions 0.8 m up, 0.32 m either side of the middle, the hips just ahead of each backrest (front row z 0.3, back row z -0.45); the steering wheel is on the left, at z 0.75. The front footwell floor is only 0.18 m under the cushion (legs stretched out under the dash), the back one 0.36 m (feet under the front seats). The roof gun over the back row is not manned (the owner's ask: a driver and three passengers who all shoot their own weapons).
notes.cockpitEye: A seated head height, under the front roof bar (1.6 m at z 0.55), looking over the wheel and dash. Up close the driver sees an in-house cockpit instead of the body's own (client content/cockpits.ts).
notes.vehicle: The Warthog feel: soft, long-travel springs (bouncy, leans out of turns), loose at speed so it powerslides.
